Name: Romanceable Rasmodia - RRRR Patch
Author: Nom0ri
Description:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/Wyr2wNX/Romanceable-Rasmodia-rrrr.png[/img][font=Comic Sans MS][b][color=#ff0000][size=5]
[/size][/color]
[size=3]You might be wondering why is this a separate mod... me too. I decided to make it like this, because of the huge number of configs and dynamic tokens that are specific only to RRRR and would make the main mod a bit too messy for my liking.
[/size][/b][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS][b][size=4]Important thingies:
[/size][/b][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Pregnancy got a bit weirder... you can only get pregnant as a female farmer and adopt when male. Why? Because magic. [/size][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2](That's just user experience, from the actual game's viewpoint it's normal)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Will not support hairstyle events (for obvious reasons), but you wouldn't be able to see them anyway.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Now provides portraits with 32 expressions[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]As of 1.1 version it is now mostly i18n replacer with some changes in the included CP mod so manual installation is highly recommended.[/size][/font]
[/list]
[b]Installation instructions:[/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Download the mod manually[/size]
[*][size=3]Unpack into the mods folder and overwrite when asked[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size]
[size=4][b]Ko-fi:
[/b][/size][size=3]If by some weird chance you'd like to support me, here's my [url=https://ko-fi.com/nomori]ko-fi [/url]page. You can safely ignore it hah
[/size]
[size=4]Credits:[/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2055798]Jellonip[/url] - for a great expansion to our favorite magic user and surviving my constant bugging about why things work like they do with all the tokens.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/17883934]LetsTussleBoiz[/url] - for helping me out with indentifying bugs in the new version and motivating me to finally get around to fixing stuff.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/86310]Async0x42[/url] - for providing an amazing script to help dealing with dialogue changes (saved hours of work and possibly my sanity)[/size][/font]
